mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has stabilized at -35.7% in the most recent week after a three-week trend of -38 to -39%, signaling a floor in decline. This stabilization at a higher level than the prior three weeks indicates the beginning of a recovery trajectory that will continue over the next four weeks, producing net positive movement in RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -38.9 to -35.7 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below -37% on average, indicating the stabilization was noise rather than a reversal signal.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PARKS mobility (from 3.0% to 14.4% over four weeks) indicates growing outdoor activity and social confidence. This behavioral shift toward public spaces signals reduced risk aversion that will extend to indoor retail venues, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 10% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS increased 11.4 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS mobility declines below 8% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC fails to rise despite PARKS remaining above 10%.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has remained stable at -22% to -27% across four weeks, indicating consistent essential-goods demand. This stability combined with RESIDENTIAL remaining flat at 6-7% suggests no major lockdown or exodus. The absence of deterioration in these anchors means RETAIL_REC will not decline further and will recover toward baseline.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM variance is 4.9 points over four weeks
fact:RESIDENTIAL variance is 1.3 points over four weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -30% or RESIDENTIAL rises above 10%, indicating a structural shift in activity patterns that would suppress retail recovery.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has remained depressed at -30 to -31% across four weeks without deterioration. If TRANSIT remains above -32% over the next two weeks, it signals no new mobility restrictions are being imposed. The absence of new restrictions will allow RETAIL_REC to recover from its current -35.7% baseline.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has not deteriorated below -31.6 over four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT falls below -35% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines despite TRANSIT remaining stable.

This deepening workplace absence in mid-August suggests summer vacation patterns. As the four-week forecast period extends into early September, workplace return will accelerate, driving commute-adjacent retail activity and lifting RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -39% in the current week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined from -39.0 to -39.6 over four weeks
regime_hint: summer vacation period transitioning to fall return
failure_condition: WORKPLACES remains below -38% for all four weeks of the forecast period, or RETAIL_REC fails to rise despite WORKPLACES recovering above -35%.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at 14.4% and GROCERY_PHARM at -22.4% in t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS falls below 8% or GROCERY_PHARM falls below -28% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines despite both conditions being met.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has shown a consistent four-week trend of oscillation between -38.9% and -35.7%, with the most recent value at -35.7% representing the least negative point. This mean-reversion pattern within a narrow band suggests the series is approaching a local floor. Over the next four weeks, reversion to the mean of this band (-37.9%) will produce a net positive movement from the current -35.7% baseline.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls below -38% in any of the next four weeks, indicating the floor hypothesis is false.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT mobility declines by more than 2 percentage points week-on-week over the next week, it signals new mobility restrictions are being implemented. Under such restrictions, RETAIL_REC will decline further from its current -35.7% level. Conversely, if TRANSIT remains stable or improves, RETAIL_REC will recover.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 2 percentage points in the next week
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains stable or improves in the next week, yet RETAIL_REC still declines by more than 2 percentage points.
